summary: Master data analytics in supply chain management with our comprehensive course. Equip yourself with the tools to improve decision-making and performance.
lede: Supply chain analytics helps planners, analysts, and operations managers use operational data to improve planning, execution, and control. The course covers data-quality checks, KPI scorecards, operational dashboards, demand forecasting, and root-cause analysis, using Excel and Power BI or Tableau alongside introductory SQL and Python concepts to support service, inventory, and transport decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to improve supply chain decisions with trusted data, practical metrics, and usable dashboards.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working familiarity with supply chain or logistics operations, basic Excel use, and comfort reading operational reports. No coding is required for completion, although introductory SQL and Python concepts are included at an operational awareness level. Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and access to sample operational data where available; datasets and lab materials are provided for the exercises. This course is suited to foundation-to-intermediate learners who want practical analytics capability, not advanced data engineering.
